propositions: Attestations satisfying the current operator-attested evidence contract lack provenance context (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument), allowing measurements taken in wrong environments or under incomparable privilege to pass unchallenged

The existing evidence contract captures only the attestation event provenance (change-id, vote, timestamp) but enforces nothing about measurement context, creating escapes where bedrock measurements from one AWS account validate work targeting a different account

Deterministic shape checking can enforce that measurement provenance fields are present, non-placeholder, and have correct enum membership before any LLM evaluation, without re-running world measurements

A tool-enabled AGENT-tier criterion can detect contradictions between declared provenance (environment account) and repo-grounded anchors (Terraform backend) by reading in-repo IaC files, catching the wrong-environment escape

Authorization claims validated via simulation or static analysis cannot be distinguished from live-call evidence by privilege_posture alone, requiring instrument as a mandatory fourth declared field to surface the distinction

The contract amendment (measurement provenance fields + deterministic presence check + LLM contradiction detection) routes through project overlay rather than shipped defaults, so no client gains a blocking criterion and pre-contract tickets grandf
